requires.name: Reference video — the film to re-angle

notes: STAGE 1 — REFERENCE FILM Paste the reference video URL here. The analyser reads it; the frame extractors pull stills that become the visual anchors for the re-shoot.
STAGE 2 — SHOOTING GRAMMAR The cinematographer node turns the raw analysis into reusable grammar: cut rhythm, focal bands, camera heights, light logic, grade — then designs 5 genuinely new angles.
STAGE 3 — RE-SHOOT One writer and one generator per new angle. Same grade, same pace, same light direction — different coverage.
STAGE 4 — ASSEMBLY All new angles cut together in order, then collected for download.
